name: Soulbox Ashtanga Yoga Jakarta
reason: Out of scope as a fitness studio: its own site (www.soulboxjakarta.com, robots.txt allows us) presents Soulbox as an urban fitness concept (boxing, TRX, bootcamp, HIIT, kettlebell, Zumba, EMS, barre, anti-gravity) with Ashtanga as one class among many, not a yoga school.
